source.title: Biding Our Time
source.description: The job is done. Better return to Ravenholdt and notify Fahrad.
source.objective: Report back to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor.
source.completion:
It seems all has gone according to plan. Good work.

All we can do now is wait for Caius to make his next move. I will notify you when that time comes. Your commitment to the manor has not been entirely fulfilled.

For now, however, you can rest easy.
